view.quick.week_prompt: What's on my calendar this week?
view.quick.page_prompt: Explain the settings page {page}: what can I set up here?
view.empty.calendar: Ask about your calendar, or open an event to work on it.
view.empty.contacts: Ask about your contacts, or open one to work with it.
view.empty.files: Ask about your files, or select some to work with them.
view.empty.settings: Ask how to set something up, or about the page you have open.
view.privacy: In Calendar, Contacts, Files and Settings it also sends what you have open there: the event, the contact, the names, types, sizes and change dates of the selected files and the folder, or the settings page.
view.settings.title: Other views and Catch me up
view.settings.everywhere: Show in Calendar, Contacts, Files and Settings
view.settings.everywhere_hint: A panel next to these views. Its button or Alt+A opens it.
brief.label: Catch me up
brief.no_waiting: Nothing is waiting for a reply.
brief.privacy: Catch me up also sends your unread mail since your last visit (sender, recipients, date, subject, first lines and message id), today's events, your open tasks and the sent mail of the last week that is waiting for a reply.
brief.settings.catch_up_hint: A summary of new mail, today's events and open tasks when no message is open. Needs the lookups.
brief.settings.waiting: Look for mail waiting for a reply
brief.settings.waiting_hint: Catch me up checks your sent mail of the last week for messages nobody answered.
view.settings.grant: To show the assistant there, turn it off and on again in {place} and allow the new permission.
